resources.string: App settings take priority; the built-in server address is hidden

Tap to upload recent logs in batches: up to 1 MiB in total, with at most 256 KiB per batch. If the limit is reached, newer records are kept and omissions are shown. No automatic uploads. Manual retry skips confirmed batches; unconfirmed batches may be duplicated.
Tap Upload to send recent logs and collected environment and permission results.
Enter the OpenObserve ingestion URL and authorization first
Uploads go to this device-specific stream. Tap to copy the name and include it when reporting issues.
Upload stopped; reports already received remain on the server
Upload result is unconfirmed: network or response error. A manual retry may create duplicates.
Upload failed: HTTP %1$d. Check the ingestion URL, authorization and permissions.

***** indicates a hidden saved value. Leave it blank to keep it. Changing the URL requires entering Authorization again. Use {HeadUnit}-{DeviceID} for the stream to insert the head unit model and device hash. Use HTTPS and dedicated ingestion credentials. HTTP is unencrypted.
Could not save settings. Please retry.
Enter /api/organization/stream/_json; the stream can use {HeadUnit}-{DeviceID} or {DeviceID}. Omit credentials, query and fragment.
Enter Basic followed by a space and Base64-encoded username:ingestion-credential
OpenObserve did not accept every record. Retrying may create duplicates.
Snapshot limit reached: %1$d older records omitted, %2$d files shortened. See the upload summary.
Matched %1$d / %2$d records · Hold a line to copy
Could not read logs. Tap Refresh to retry.
Copy failed. Narrow the search and retry.
These logs exceed the clipboard limit. Copy each part in order; no content is truncated.
Clear retained runtime and environment logs on this device and stop the current upload. New logs will still be recorded. Uploaded logs are unaffected.
Delete environment and permission report history stored in the app. Exported files and log records are kept.
Reports are being collected or processed. Wait until this finishes before clearing.
Some content could not be cleared. Please retry.
